book.title: Shilǝn ki Lya a toh ɗǝ Malkus

content: Cimbǝlti ki Mul Otlti Lǝɓa

Ɗaɗanu Yesu a gop kulci'si shilǝn ki Lya abi dlilka u ɓalu, I' mbalǝn mil diɓǝlti domga amati, I lati, i'te ge' kundǝlǝn ki mali, Adlǝlka, i' dǝm a giɓi. I' dopga ki mbalǝn dlǝl atǝn bǝgasi abi dlǝlka isi.
I' kulcisi lǝɓa diɓǝli nǝ cibǝlti. A ge kulcisiwasi i' ulsisu,
“Ga kǝn kum! Mulǝn mul kotllu won ɗa is zǝga gegu tǝn gaki ti' wotl o'.
Tige dlati wundi lǝɓa, Ina wundiyen nda tǝn shutu, i yatli ɗakǝn unndiyisi.
Un ndiyen is nda age lu mul zǝnga luwu nǝ bǝ atl ɗa iye wai u. Alǝbi alǝbi is te' tǝn gaki atli loluwai.
Nǝ cin peku, Is landǝli, tǝn gaki dlǝlgwasǝn loluwai, Is kwakǝni.
I gyen nda age ili, I ili sǝnkǝlsi, Sa man pǝtl gwewai.
I gyen ɗaɗanu is nda gye lu atl ki zeki, Is te' kizeki, Is nali, Is pǝl gwe, I gyen pǝl gwe kutl kutl lǝbi maki, Gyen kutl kutl lǝbi mǝkka, Gyen kutl kutl lǝbi kutl.” I Yesu usu,
“Mul kǝm ki kumti tǝ'kumi.”
Ulnǝ Lati Ɗǝ Cimbǝlti u
Nǝs pal mal gǝni u, Mil bǝtlti nǝ kutl nǝ lopiyi iki is gyemti yakǝn cimbǝlti u ɗǝ dlǝmti.
Iki i' ulsisu, “Kini ɓo, a ndǝgikini i kimannǝn tuki libi ki Lya, Gyen ginǝ bǝ ɗa gyekini wai u, Sai nǝ cimbǝlti.
“ ‘Yenti nǝ dwaɗǝn ɓo, Sa yeniyi, bǝ a mbatldlwai. Kumti ɓo, Sa kumiyi, Sa man ulnǝ ɗǝ dlǝmti u wai, Tǝn gaki, ɓaspaltyai a pacisi bezǝn lǝɓa wasǝn ɗa.’ ”
Yesu Dlǝm Cimbǝlti Ki Mul Wotlti Unndi
Yesu ulsisu, “A!, Kimanǝn ciɓǝlti uwayya? Tu i mi kǝnkimanǝn na ciɓǝlti en ɗa?
Mul wotlti o' u, Shilǝn ki Lya kǝnti wotlti.
Ginǝ ndatǝn shutu u ɓo, Siki ciɓǝlti ki gǝnǝ wotl shilǝn ki Lya a mbatl dlwasǝn u. Sǝn kup shilǝn nisi, Alǝbi alǝbi a shaidan kam shilǝn u nǝ wotldli a mbadlwasǝn u.
Nǝguni ɗaɗanu gunǝ wotl unndi o' a ge lu zǝnga u, Siki ginǝ sǝn kup shilǝn ki Lya as kami nǝ hwoltugi.
Si ɓo, Gǝs nisi ɗawai, si kǝn dǝm iye wai, ko ulukǝn hwossi tǝngaki shilǝn ki Lya u, Alǝbi alǝbi as pal nǝ kali.
Unndi ginǝ nda gelu ili u, iki ciɓǝlti ki mbalǝn u nǝ kum shilǝn ki Lya u,
Dǝp lǝɓa a hwosi u, nǝ lyap usǝn u, Nǝ laki lǝɓa u, Nǝnte'ti gesi asǝnkǝl shilǝn nisi, Ashilǝn nisi kǝn dǝmti kizeki masiwai.

Undi u nǝ nda age luki zeki u, iki cimbǝlti ki mbalǝn u nǝkum shilǝnisi, Sǝn kamti, As pǝl kyautǝn nǝ nali, As mbi mbǝlti tǝnki gyen kutl kutl lǝbi maki, Gyen kutl kutl lǝbi mǝkka, Gyenɓo kutl kutl lǝbi kutl.”
Cibǝlti Atǝn Pitila
Yesu ulsisu, “Nǝn mbǝtl pitila teɗi a idlati nǝ bal gala, ko nǝnzǝdli agǝs lumutti, kin zǝti atǝn lu dǝmtuwa swaya?
Kum ulnǝ ki hwundǝli u, nǝn pekǝlti. Ulnǝ ki kuppi u, nǝn ɗutiti.
Mul kǝm ki kumti, ti' kumi.”
Yesu ulsisu, “Kumini, ko'talaku' nǝ cimbǝlin ɗa u, nǝ nali si' cimbǝlliki, hal ma as mbǝli ɗa.
Tǝngaki mulnǝ ulǝn ni'ɗa u, sim mbǝli' tiɗa, mulnǝ ulǝn ni' ɗawai u, na' ulnǝ nitu sin kamiti taka.”
Cimbǝlti Ki Unndu nǝ Ate u
Yesu ulsisu, “Gu' ki libi ki Lya kǝnǝ mul dlati u'kǝni a atli.
Mutti nǝ hillya i undi te, i nali, timan kan u nǝ pǝl dli uwai.
Atli nǝ gawasi ti bǝtl lǝɓa, ki nǝm iki ulnǝ ɗǝ te'ti, sai ga, nǝ balgye laɓa tǝnki.
In gwe yi a nyau, iki alǝbi alǝbi atlo'dli nǝ kwaltǝn, gis acilu ngu.”
Cimbǝlti nǝ Gwe' Mastad
I' usu ɗaɗanu, “Nǝ yakǝn tǝn cimbǝlǝn gu' ki Lya? Ko nǝ yakǝn tǝn cimbǝlǝnti?
Kǝnǝ gwe mastad kǝnɗa, gunǝ, iki yakǝn gwe lǝɓa gunǝ ɗǝ wotlti adǝp lǝɓa u,
Ngo nǝ nǝgu in wotl tu, an ngǝtl kap na dwa nǝ nalti, ap pǝlbas mil toh, yatl ma as man nda a gwasǝn wasi.”
Nǝ cimbǝlti diɓǝli Yesu dlǝm misi shilǝn ki Lya, ndace nǝ mantiwasǝn.
Ti ɗa pissi ulǝnwai, sai nǝ cimbǝlti. Iki ti pi' mil kushtiwasi ko yanngi a malgǝni bǝ nǝ cimbǝltiwai.
Age'cinisi, nǝ cin ɓalnja ti nda u, i Yesu ul mil kushti wassu, “Mi' ɗakǝcin tyatǝn bi dlǝlka ka.”
Nǝsza dopga ki mbalǝn akalu, is zǝga neti kau u nǝ tiɗa u age kundǝlǝn ki mali, na kundǝlǝn ki mali si amalgǝn wasi.
I bal lya ki mali mul yetǝl dlitoɗi, i bǝski mali go' tliti lya ɗǝ lyap jakǝ' kuɗǝlǝ nisi.
Yesu ɓo ati tu kal age kundǝlǝn ki mali atǝn lumutti, ati nde enbuɗi. Iki mil kushtiwasi is dlilti ɗǝ enɓuɗi, is ultisu, “Mul lashti, mun mǝshti kin ɗa entiwaya?”
I' hilya ɗǝ enɓuɗi, i' mati etǝlli, i ultisu “dǝm shot!” Iki i yetǝlli muɗi, i kumlu dǝm shot.
I' ulsisu, “Tǝn gaki yakǝn lakiɗa ikumǝn ɓanti nǝgu? Hal nǝgun lati mbatl kǝn nuna?”
Iskum ɓanti iye, is ulyelsǝnisu, “Wo kǝngu? Yetǝl nǝ mali ki dlika si bǝtl shilǝn wasi!”
